scholars.text: The key to happiness is to know what is good and to cling to it
scholars.arabic: مفتاح السعادة أن تعرف الخير و تتمسك به

scholars.text: The heart is like a vessel, and knowledge is what fills it

scholars.text: The soul is purified by remembering Allah, and corrupted by remembering other than Him

scholars.text: The best of deeds is to make the heart humble and submissive to Allah

scholars.text: Knowledge is the basis of all good, and ignorance is the basis of all evil
scholars.arabic: العلم أساس كل خير و الجهل أساس كل شر

scholars.text: The one who seeks knowledge should be like a thirsty person, who drinks water with eagerness

scholars.text: The seeking of knowledge is an obligation upon every Muslim

scholars.text: The one who follows the Sunnah is like a person who holds onto a strong rope

scholars.text: The Quran is a cure for the diseases of the heart

scholars.text: The one who is guided by reason and revelation will never go astray

scholars.text: The one who is patient in times of hardship will be rewarded with a great reward

scholars.text: The one who remembers Allah in times of ease will be remembered by Him in times of hardship

scholars.text: The one who knows himself knows his Lord

scholars.text: The one who loves for the sake of Allah will be loved by Him

scholars.text: The one who seeks knowledge should be humble and submissive

scholars.text: The one who follows the Sunnah will be guided to the straight path

scholars.text: The one who is truthful in his words will be granted a high rank by Allah

scholars.text: The Quran is a book of wisdom and guidance

scholars.text: The one who contemplates the creation of Allah will come to know His greatness

scholars.text: The one who seeks knowledge should be like a traveler, who travels with a purpose
scholars.arabic: من أراد العلم فليكن كالصاحب الذي يسافر لهدف

scholars.text: The one who is patient in times of hardship will be rewarded with a great reward in the Hereafter

scholars.text: The one who remembers Allah in times of ease will be given strength in times of hardship

scholars.text: The one who knows himself knows his weaknesses and his strengths
scholars.arabic: من عرف نفسه عرفضعفه وقوته

scholars.text: The one who loves for the sake of Allah will be loved by the angels and the believers
scholars.arabic: من أحب لله أحبه الملائكة و المؤمنون

scholars.text: The one who seeks knowledge should be like a seeker of treasure, who searches with eagerness
scholars.arabic: من أراد العلم فليكن كالطالب للكنز الذي يبحث بحرص

scholars.text: The one who follows the Sunnah will be guided to the straight path and will be spared from the punishment of Allah

scholars.text: The heart is like a tree, and knowledge is its fruit.
scholars.arabic: القلب شجرة، وال科学 ثمرها

scholars.text: The best of deeds is to bring happiness to a Muslim.
scholars.arabic: أفضل الأعمال إسعاد المسلم

scholars.text: The seeking of knowledge is an obligation upon every Muslim.
scholars.arabic: طلب العلم فرض على كل مسلم

scholars.text: The most virtuous of deeds is to speak the truth, even if it is bitter.
scholars.arabic: أفضل الأعمال قول الحق ولو كان مرا

scholars.text: The believer is the mirror of the believer, so if you see a fault in your brother, try to remove it.

scholars.text: The key to happiness is to be content with what Allah has decreed.
scholars.arabic: مفتاح السعادة الرضا بما قضى الله

scholars.arabic: كمال الإيمان في ترك ما لا يعنيه

scholars.text: The servant of Allah will not attain true freedom until he frees himself from the slavery of his desires.
scholars.arabic: لا يصل العبد إلى الحرية الحقة حتى يفر himself من رق شواهه
scholars.source: Al-Furqan bayna Awliya al-Rahman wa Awliya al-Shaytan

scholars.text: The best of companions is the one who reminds you of Allah.
scholars.arabic: خير الصحبة من يذكرك الله

scholars.text: The key to the door of knowledge is to ask questions.
scholars.arabic: مفتاح باب العلم السؤال

scholars.text: The one who is deprived of kindness is deprived of everything.
scholars.arabic: من حُرم الرحمة حُرم كل شيء

scholars.text: The foundation of the religion is the intention.
scholars.arabic: أصل الدين النية

scholars.text: The one who follows his desires will be destroyed by them.
scholars.arabic: من اتبع هواه أهلكه

scholars.text: The believer is not bitten from the same hole twice.
scholars.arabic: ليس للمؤمن ملسع من الجحر مرتين

scholars.text: The one who knows himself knows his Lord.
scholars.arabic: من عرف نفسه عرف ربه

scholars.text: The servant of Allah will not attain true humility until he humbles himself before the creation of Allah.
scholars.arabic: لا يصل العبد إلى الخشوع الحقيقي حتى يخضع لخلقة الله

scholars.text: The one who is sincere in his devotion to Allah will be granted strength and power.

scholars.source: Al-Furqan bayna Awliya al-Rahman wa Awliya al-Shaytan

scholars.text: The one who remembers Allah in times of ease will be remembered by Allah in times of hardship.

scholars.text: The one who is patient in times of hardship will be granted relief and ease.

scholars.text: The one who seeks knowledge for the sake of Allah will be granted wisdom and understanding.
scholars.arabic: من طلب العلم لله تعالى أوتي الحكمة والفهم

scholars.text: The one who fears Allah will be feared by the creation of Allah.
scholars.arabic: من خاف الله خافته خلقة الله

scholars.text: The one who is grateful for the blessings of Allah will be granted more blessings.
scholars.arabic: من شكر الله على نعمته أوتي مزيدا من النعم

scholars.text: The one who knows the value of time will be granted success and prosperity.
scholars.arabic: من عرف قيمة الوقت أوتي النجاح والرزق

scholars.text: The one who seeks knowledge and acts upon it will be granted a high rank in the hereafter.
scholars.arabic: من طلب العلم وعمل به أوتي منزلة عالية في الآخرة

scholars.text: The one who loves Allah and His Messenger will be loved by Allah and His angels.
scholars.arabic: من أحب الله ورسوله أحبه الله وملايكته
scholars.source: Al-Furqan bayna Awliya al-Rahman wa Awliya al-Shaytan

scholars.text: The heart is like a mirror, it reflects what is in it

scholars.text: The highest degree of wisdom is to know one's own ignorance

scholars.text: The greatest of all struggles is the struggle against the self

scholars.text: The foundation of all good deeds is sincerity

scholars.text: The seeker of knowledge should be like a bee, taking from every flower

scholars.arabic: من عمل بعلمه، جزاه الله عند الله

scholars.text: The heart is like a tree, if it is watered with the remembrance of Allah, it will produce fruits of righteousness
scholars.arabic: القلب شجرة إن سقي بذكر الله أنتج ثمر الفلاح

scholars.text: The basis of our religion is the Quran and the Hadith, and the understanding of the companions
scholars.arabic: أصل ديننا القرآن والحديث وفهم الصحابة

scholars.text: There is no obedience to the creation in disobedience to the Creator
scholars.arabic: لا طاعة للمخلوق في معصية الخالق

scholars.text: The one who busies himself with the faults of others, will be blind to his own faults
scholars.arabic: من شغله عيوب الناس عن عيوب نفسه

scholars.text: The one who is given knowledge and acts upon it, will be given more knowledge
scholars.arabic: من أوتي العلم وعمل به زيادةknowledge

scholars.text: The seeking of knowledge is an obligation upon every Muslim
scholars.arabic: طلب العلم فرض على كل مسلم

scholars.text: The one who follows the Sunnah, will be guided to the straight path
scholars.arabic: من اتبع السنة أهدي إلى الصراط المستقيم

scholars.text: The Quran is the rope of Allah, whoever holds onto it, will be saved
scholars.arabic: القرآن حبل الله من اعتصم به نجا

scholars.text: The intellect is the tool of the believer, and the ignorance is the tool of the disbeliever
scholars.arabic: العقل أداة المؤمن والجهل أداة الكافر

scholars.text: The one who is given wisdom, has been given a great blessing
scholars.arabic: من أوتي الحكمة أوتي خير كثير

scholars.text: The one who is patient, will be given a reward that is greater than the deed
scholars.arabic: من صبر ظفرajrah أكبر من العمل

scholars.text: The one who follows the Hadith, will be guided to the truth
scholars.arabic: من اتبع الحديث أهدي إلى الحق

scholars.text: The one who is truthful, will be given a tongue that is trustworthy
scholars.arabic: من صدق أوتي لسانا مصدقا

scholars.text: The one who is given wealth and uses it for the sake of Allah, will be given a great reward
scholars.arabic: من أوتي المال وأنفق في سبيل الله أوتي أجرا كبيرا

scholars.text: The one who remembers Allah, will be remembered by Allah
scholars.arabic: من ذكر الله ذكرَه الله

scholars.text: The one who follows the Quran, will be guided to the straight path
scholars.arabic: من اتبع القرآن أهدي إلى الصراط المستقيم

scholars.text: The one who is humble, will be exalted by Allah
scholars.arabic: من تواضع رفعه الله

scholars.text: The one who recites the Quran, will be given a reward for every letter
scholars.arabic: من قرأ القرآن أوتي أجر لكل حرف

scholars.text: The one who is given knowledge, has been given a great blessing
scholars.arabic: من أوتي العلم أوتي خير كبير

scholars.text: The one who follows the Sunnah, will be saved from the Fire
scholars.arabic: من اتبع السنة نجا من النار

scholars.text: The one who is patient in times of hardship, will be given a reward that is greater than the hardship
scholars.arabic: من صبر على الشدة أوتي أجر أكبر من الشدة

scholars.text: The one who is given wisdom, will be able to distinguish between right and wrong
scholars.arabic: من أوتي الحكمة أستطاع أن يفرق بين الحق والباطل

scholars.text: The one who is truthful, will be given a good end
scholars.arabic: من صدق ختم له بخير

scholars.text: The one who remembers Allah, will be given a sense of tranquility
scholars.arabic: من ذكر الله أوتي سکینة

scholars.text: The one who follows the Hadith, will be guided to the truth
scholars.arabic: من اتبع الحديث أهدي إلى الحق

scholars.text: The one who seeks knowledge, will be given a light that will guide him
scholars.arabic: من طلب العلم أوتي نور يهديه

scholars.text: The heart is like a tree, if it is nourished with good deeds, it will bear fruit, but if it is nourished with evil deeds, it will wither and die
scholars.arabic: القلب شجرة، إن أغذيتها بالحسنات ثمرت، وإن أغذيتها بالسيئات جفت وماتت

scholars.text: The seeking of knowledge is an obligation upon every Muslim, and it is the key to the door of happiness
scholars.arabic: طلب العلم فرض على كل مسلم، وهو مفتاح باب السعادة

scholars.text: The world is a bridge, cross it, but do not build your house upon it
scholars.arabic: الدنيا桥، اعبرها، ولا تبنها

scholars.text: The one who follows his desires will be destroyed, and the one who follows the truth will be saved
scholars.arabic: من اتبع هواه هلک، ومن اتبع الحق نجا

scholars.text: The greatest jihad is to struggle against one's own self
scholars.arabic: أعظم الجهاد جهاد النفس

scholars.text: The one who memorizes the Quran and acts upon it will be with the noble and righteous angels
scholars.arabic: من حفظ القرآن وعمل به كان مع المَلائكة الكِرام

scholars.text: The one who seeks knowledge for the sake of Allah will be granted knowledge, and the one who seeks it for the sake of the world will be granted the world
scholars.arabic: من طلب العلم لله أعطاه الله العلم، ومن طلب العلم للدنيا أعطاه الله الدنيا

scholars.text: The one who is guided by Allah will never be misled, and the one who is misled by Allah will never be guided
scholars.arabic: من هداه الله لم يضل، ومن أضل الله لم يهتدي

scholars.text: The one who reflects upon the signs of Allah will be granted wisdom and insight
scholars.arabic: من تأمل آيات الله أعطاه الله الحكمة والبصيرة

scholars.text: The one who is patient in times of difficulty will be granted relief and ease
scholars.arabic: من صبر على المشقة سigrه الله الفرج والرخاء

scholars.text: The one who seeks knowledge for the sake of argumentation will be punished, and the one who seeks it for the sake of guidance will be rewarded
scholars.arabic: من طلب العلم للجدل عوقب، ومن طلب العلم للهداية ثواب

scholars.text: The one who is truthful in his words will be granted a strong heart and a firm resolve
scholars.arabic: من صدق في قوله قوي قلبه وثبت عزمه

scholars.text: The one who follows the Sunnah will be saved from the darkness of innovation
scholars.arabic: من اتبع السنة نجا من ظلمات البدع

scholars.text: The one who performs his prayers with sincerity will be granted forgiveness and mercy
scholars.arabic: من صلاه بихلاص نیغفر له ويرحمه

scholars.text: The one who is humble in his heart will be exalted in his rank
scholars.arabic: من تواضع في قلبه رفعه الله في درجته

scholars.text: The one who recites the Quran with reflection will be granted understanding and insight
scholars.arabic: من قرأ القرآن بالتدبر أوتي الفهم والبصيرة

scholars.text: The one who seeks knowledge for the sake of fame will be punished, and the one who seeks it for the sake of Allah will be rewarded
scholars.arabic: من طلب العلم للشهرة عوقب، ومن طلب العلم لله ثواب

scholars.text: The one who is grateful for the blessings of Allah will be granted more blessings
scholars.arabic: من شكر الله على نعمه أضاعفه الله

scholars.text: The one who is patient in times of hardship will be granted ease and comfort
scholars.arabic: من صبر على المشقة سigrه الله الرخاء والفردوس

scholars.text: The one who seeks knowledge for the sake of Allah will be granted wisdom and insight
scholars.arabic: من طلب العلم لله أعطاه الله الحكمة والبصيرة

scholars.text: The one who is truthful in his words will be granted a strong heart and a firm resolve
scholars.arabic: من صدق في قوله قوي قلبه وثبت عزمه

scholars.text: The one who follows the Sunnah will be saved from the darkness of innovation
scholars.arabic: من اتبع السنة نجا من ظلمات البدع

scholars.text: The one who performs his prayers with sincerity will be granted forgiveness and mercy
scholars.arabic: من صلاه بيهلاص نیغفر له ويرحمه

scholars.text: The one who is humble in his heart will be exalted in his rank
scholars.arabic: من تواضع في قلبه رفعه الله في درجته

scholars.text: The one who recites the Quran with reflection will be granted understanding and insight
scholars.arabic: من قرأ القرآن بالتدبر أوتي الفهم والبصيرة

scholars.text: The one who seeks knowledge for the sake of Allah will be granted wisdom and insight
scholars.arabic: من طلب العلم لله أعطاه الله الحكمة والبصيرة
